text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 60, "unit": "dogs", "kind": "count", "span": "the number of dogs is 60"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 2, "unit": "cats", "kind": "count", "span": "two cats for every dog"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 12, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "twelve less than the combined number"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "cats: two for every one of the 60 dogs"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "s1"], "out": "s2", "note": "dogs and cats combined"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s2", "q3"], "out": "s3", "note": "rabbits: twelve less than the dogs and cats combined"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s2", "s3"], "out": "s4", "note": "every pet in the neighborhood"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "how many pets in total are in the neighborhood"}, "dismissed": []}
